tone.h2:
Native amp or a capture
of a real one, same chain.
tone.lede: Pick the amp model built into the app or load a .nam captured from a real amp. Both run in the same chain, at the buffer size you set.
captures.lede: A capture pack ships dozens of .nam files — one per gain setting, channel and mic. Everywhere else you open them one at a time. OpenRig's plugins come with the whole pack already mapped to knobs: turn Gain and the right capture loads itself.
captures.cap1.h3: Turn a knob, not a list
captures.cap1.p: Move the Gain knob and the matching capture loads underneath. It behaves like the amp, not like a file browser.
captures.cap2.p: Rust DSP built in, neural amp captures, LV2 and VST3 plugins and impulse responses — all five load into the same chain.
captures.cap3.p: Got a .nam or a cab IR on disk? Load it straight into a block and it plays in the chain like any other amp.
rig.lede: No menus, no parameter lists. Pedals, amps and cabs sit in a row like a pedalboard, and the knob you want is where you expect it.
rig.cap1.p: Drag a knob and hear it move. Every control responds the moment you touch it.
rig.cap2.p: Pedals in front, cabs behind, drag anything to reorder it.
rig.cap3.p: Found it? Save the preset. It's still there at soundcheck next month.
band.lede: Guitar, acoustic and a vocal mic at the same time — each with its own chain, its own gear and its own outputs. Nothing bleeds between them.
inst.lede: Pick the instrument and OpenRig shows only the gear that fits it.
inst.i1.p: Amps, cabs, drives, the whole board.
inst.i4.p: A generic rig for whatever the session needs.
inst.note: Bass and keys rigs are next up.
gig.lede: Rehearsal room, living room or a stage with a click in your in-ears — it behaves the same every night.
gig.c1.p: The signal goes out and comes back fast enough that your hands never notice the computer.
gig.c2.p: Change amp, add a pedal or load a preset while you're playing. No gap, no pop, no dead bar.
gig.c3.p: You already have an audio interface to plug the guitar into. Everything after it — amp, cab, pedals — runs on the computer.
app.lede: Instruments on the left, gear in the middle, outputs on the right. That's the whole app.
app.caption: Every knob, every parameter — one screen.
